question: Roquefortine C is found in ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**cheese**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Roquefortine C:**

 
 
• A **naturally occurring 2,5-diketopiperazine** class of mycotoxin is known as** roquefortine C.**
 
• It is generated by a **variety of fungi,** mainly those from the **genus Penicillium.**
 
• It was first discovered in a strain of the** bacterium Penicillium roqueforti.**
 
• Penicillium roqueforti is utilized commercially as a source of** proteolytic and lipolytic enzymes** in the maturing of** blue-veined cheeses** such as **Roquefort, Danish Blue, Stilton, and Gorgonzola. **
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A common and widely distributed **saprophytic fungus** is **Penicillium roqueforti.**
 
• It is possible to isolate it from the **soil, decomposing organic matter, and plant materials.**
 
• This fungus is mostly used in industry to make** blue cheese, flavoring compounds, antibacterials, polysaccharides, proteases**, and other enzymes.
 
• They do create** human poisons and allergens,** in addition to other **antibacterial metabolites,** but no medically effective **antibiotics.**
